audit_status.source_base: Greek Hebrews text tradition; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for mature foundation, severe warning, better things, Abraham promise, oath, anchor of soul.

verses.restored: Therefore, leaving the beginning word of Messiah, let us be carried toward maturity, not again laying foundation of turning from dead works and trust toward Divine,

familiar.text: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

modern.text: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,

original.text: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ Χριστοῦ λόγον ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα φερώμεθα, μὴ πάλιν θεμέλιον καταβαλλόμενοι μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ θεόν,

verses.restored: teaching of washings, laying on of hands, resurrection of dead ones, and age-long judgment.

familiar.text: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

modern.text: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

original.text: βαπτισμῶν ⸀διδαχὴν ἐπιθέσεώς τε χειρῶν, ἀναστάσεώς ⸀τε νεκρῶν καὶ κρίματος αἰωνίου.

verses.restored: And this we will do, if the Divine permits.

familiar.text: And this will we do, if God permit.

modern.text: And this we will do, if God permits.

original.text: καὶ τοῦτο ⸀ποιήσομεν ἐάνπερ ἐπιτρέπῃ ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: For it is impossible for those once enlightened, tasting the heavenly gift, becoming partners of holy Spirit,

familiar.text: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,

modern.text: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

original.text: Ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας πνεύματος ἁγίου

verses.restored: and tasting beautiful/good word of Divine and powers of coming age,

familiar.text: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

modern.text: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—

original.text: καὶ καλὸν γευσαμένους θεοῦ ῥῆμα δυνάμεις τε μέλλοντος αἰῶνος,

verses.restored: and falling away, to renew again into turning, since they are re-crucifying for themselves the Son of the Divine and exposing him to public shame.

familiar.text: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.

modern.text: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.

original.text: καὶ παραπεσόντας, πάλιν ἀνακαινίζειν εἰς μετάνοιαν, ἀνασταυροῦντας ἑαυτοῖς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας.

verses.restored: For earth drinking rain often coming upon it and bringing forth useful plant for those through whom it is cultivated shares blessing from the Divine.

familiar.text: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

modern.text: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.

original.text: γῆ γὰρ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ⸂ἐρχόμενον πολλάκις⸃ ὑετόν, καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις διʼ οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται, μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ·

verses.restored: But bearing thorns and thistles is disapproved and near curse, whose end is burning.

familiar.text: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

modern.text: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.

original.text: ἐκφέρουσα δὲ ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς, ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν.

verses.restored: But concerning you, beloved, we have been persuaded of better things, things holding to salvation/healing, even if we speak this way.

familiar.text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

modern.text: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.

original.text: Πεπείσμεθα δὲ περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀγαπητοί, τὰ κρείσσονα καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, εἰ καὶ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν·

verses.restored: For the Divine is not unjust to forget your work and the love you showed toward his name, having served the holy ones and still serving.

familiar.text: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

modern.text: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.

original.text: οὐ γὰρ ἄδικος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ ἔργου ὑμῶν ⸀καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες.

verses.restored: But we desire each of you to show the same eagerness toward full assurance of hope until completion,

familiar.text: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

modern.text: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.

original.text: ἐπιθυμοῦμεν δὲ ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὴν αὐτὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι σπουδὴν πρὸς τὴν πληροφορίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἄχρι τέλους,

verses.restored: so that you may not become sluggish, but imitators of those through trust and patience inheriting the promises.

familiar.text: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

modern.text: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised. God’s Unchangeable Promise

original.text: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε, μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας.

verses.restored: For when the Divine promised Abraham, since he had no one greater by whom to swear, he swore by himself,

familiar.text: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

modern.text: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,

original.text: Τῷ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπαγγειλάμενος ὁ θεός, ἐπεὶ κατʼ οὐδενὸς εἶχεν μείζονος ὀμόσαι, ὤμοσεν καθʼ ἑαυτοῦ,

verses.restored: saying: Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.

familiar.text: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

modern.text: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”

original.text: λέγων· ⸀Εἰ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε·

verses.restored: And so, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

familiar.text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

modern.text: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.

original.text: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.

verses.restored: For humans swear by the greater, and for them oath is end of every dispute as confirmation.

familiar.text: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

modern.text: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.

original.text: ⸀ἄνθρωποι γὰρ κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος ὀμνύουσιν, καὶ πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας πέρας εἰς βεβαίωσιν ὁ ὅρκος·

verses.restored: In this, the Divine, desiring more abundantly to show to heirs of promise the unchangeable nature of his purpose, mediated with oath,

familiar.text: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

modern.text: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.

original.text: ἐν ᾧ περισσότερον βουλόμενος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιδεῖξαι τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς βουλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ,

verses.restored: so that through two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for Divine to lie, we who fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to seize the hope set before us.

familiar.text: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

modern.text: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.

original.text: ἵνα διὰ δύο πραγμάτων ἀμεταθέτων, ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον ψεύσασθαι ⸀θεόν, ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν ἔχωμεν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς προκειμένης ἐλπίδος·

verses.restored: We have this as anchor of soul/life, secure and firm and entering inside the veil,

familiar.text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

modern.text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

original.text: ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν ἔχομεν τῆς ψυχῆς, ⸀ἀσφαλῆ τε καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος,

verses.restored: where Jesus entered as forerunner on our behalf, having become high priest into the age according to order of Melchizedek.

familiar.text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

modern.text: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

original.text: ὅπου πρόδρομος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς, κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἀρχιερεὺς γενόμενος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

translation_notes: Hebrews 6 warning is severe but immediately followed by confidence in better things and Divine remembrance of love-service.
Anchor imagery is central: hope enters inside the veil through Jesus as forerunner.
Abraham promise/oath continuity should not be read as replacement of Israel but as trust in Divine promise.
safety_note: Do not use Hebrews 6 to terrorize tender consciences. The text warns against catastrophic abandonment while assuring the beloved community that their love-service is remembered by a just Divine.
